name: kill_switch_disable_audit_20261022
comment: ANCHOR: KILL_SWITCH_DISABLE_AUDIT_20261022 — kill_switches.disable() passed confirm_phrase= to _audit() whose
parameter was confirm=, so every correctly-confirmed disable raised TypeError (operator hit it 2026-10-22 21:53 ET).
Covers disable success+audit row, wrong/date-bound phrase refusal, enable unchanged, rollback on any write failure
(state + audit commit together or not at all), CLI rc 1 on refusal/failure. Hermetic: fake conn/cursor, fake db_adapter
and audit_ledger; no DB, no broker.
